name: Name
uploadPreview: Upload sprite / preview PNG, JPG or WebP
avatarDescription: The slot defines the avatar layer and prevents incorrect overlaps.
spriteDescription: Upload or replace the avatar item spritesheet.
textureDescription: Textures are lightweight: they do not collide and apply to floors or walls.
worldDescription: Footprint occupies tiles, surface allows stacking, and origin anchors the sprite on the map.
worldItemsDescription: Advanced configuration for furniture, decoration, NPCs and interactive objects.
walkableDescription: Users can walk on top of it.
rotatableDescription: It can be rotated inside the room.
interactableDescription: It can react to clicks or actions.
allowsStacking: Allows objects to be placed on top
canBeStacked: Can be placed on other objects
createWorldItemDescription: World items reuse the existing item flow. Create the base item first and then configure its world data from the list.
createTextureDescription: Create floor tiles or wall textures to sell in the shop.
loadItemsAnimationsError: Could not load items or animations
missingSpriteDataError: Missing data: image, item and animation are required
dropzoneText: Drag the image here or click to select
confirmDeleteItem: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
uploadSpriteRequiredError: You must upload a sprite or preview.
footprintTileRequiredError: Define at least one footprint tile.
onlyImagesForSpriteError: Only images are allowed for Item Sprite.
readOnlyModeNotice: Read-only mode: you can inspect all technical data without modifying the object.
coinsHint: Price in in-game coins. Example: 100 coins.
gemsHint: Price in premium gems (optional). Leave at 0 if not applicable.
rarityHint: Sets the border color of the item in the inventory and shop.
languageHint: Language of this item's name and description.
slotHint: Body part where the item is equipped. Determines the draw layer (e.g. keeps a hat from rendering behind the hair).
animationHint: Avatar animation state this sprite is shown for (e.g. idle, walk).
frameWidthHint: Width in pixels of each frame in the spritesheet.
frameHeightHint: Height in pixels of each frame in the spritesheet.
framesHint: Total number of frames in the animation row.
rowHint: Spritesheet row this animation is on (0 = first row).
textureKindHint: Whether the texture applies to the floor or the wall.
worldKindHint: Functional category of the object: furniture, decoration, NPC or interactive.
placementTypeHint: Where it can be placed inside a room: floor, wall or both.
footprintWidthHint: Number of tiles the object occupies across.
footprintHeightHint: Number of tiles the object occupies deep.
stackHeightHint: Visual height (px) this object adds when something is placed on top.
maxStackHeightHint: Maximum accumulated height allowed when stacking objects on this one.
noBodyItemFound: No BODY item has been created yet
configureSpriteElsewhereHint: The animated sprite (with real body preview and all 8 directions) is configured in the dedicated editor.
